# Overview {-}

**Question.** What is the cellular-component make-up of the insoluble skeletal-muscle proteome in old Control, Exercise and Rapamycin mice, and do exercise and mTOR inhibition change composition, abundance and protein detection differently in females and males?

**Design.** Old Control, Old + Exercise and Old + Rapamycin mice of both sexes (Treatment × Sex, 3 × 2). Every protein is assigned to **one** GO Cellular Component bin, and the same preprocessing and reproducibility filter are used throughout. Results are given for the combined analysis (sexes pooled within treatment) and for a sex-resolved analysis (six Treatment × Sex groups).

> **Scope.** The Treatment, Sex and Treatment × Sex tests in this report are **composition-level tests of cellular-component fractions and summed abundance**. Protein-level differential abundance (limma) is in the separate Insoluble report and is not repeated here.

**Methods in brief**

| Step | What is done |
|---|---|
| Detection | A protein is *detected* in a sample when its raw intensity is > 0; zeros and missing values are non-detections. Raw (non-log) intensities are used for abundance weighting. |
| GO-CC bins | The first listed gene symbol is annotated; each prespecified GO root is expanded with `GOCCOFFSPRING`; a protein gets the **first matching bin** in a fixed priority order |
| Reproducibility filter | Keep a protein detected in **≥ 2 samples in Control OR Exercise OR Rapamycin** (sexes pooled within treatment) |
| Composition | **Abundance-weighted:** summed raw intensity of a bin ÷ total of all assigned, filtered proteins in that sample. **Count-weighted:** detected proteins in a bin ÷ all detected, assigned proteins in that sample (zero bin × sample combinations are kept). |
| Composition tests | Per-sample fractions are arcsine-square-root transformed. Treatment only: `Fraction_asin ~ Treatment`. Factorial: `Fraction_asin ~ Treatment * Sex` (Type III *F* tests, sum-to-zero contrasts). The primary intervention tests are **planned contrasts** from the full six-group model: **Exercise vs Control**, **Exercise × Sex**, **Rapamycin vs Control**, **Rapamycin × Sex**. Treatment contrasts average Female and Male effects equally; each interaction asks whether the treatment-versus-Control effect differs between males and females. Benjamini–Hochberg FDR across bins, separately for each of the four contrast families. Omnibus Treatment × Sex statistics are kept as secondary summaries. |
| Summed raw abundance | Per sample and bin, summed raw insoluble intensity (shown on the raw A.U. scale). Inference on `log2(sum + pseudocount)`, where the pseudocount is half the smallest positive sum, with the same six-group model and planned contrasts; sex-specific Exercise − Control and Rapamycin − Control effects as log2 fold-changes with 95% CIs. |
| Effect sizes | **Percentage-point:** Treatment − Control in % of total insoluble abundance (linear contrasts on the displayed scale). **Within-bin relative:** `100 × (Treatment − Control) / Control` (95% CIs by the delta method). Combined and sex-specific versions. Descriptive complements to the planned-contrast tests. |
| Detection tests | Two-sided Fisher exact tests of Control vs Exercise and Control vs Rapamycin detection per protein (pooled, and separately within each sex); BH within each analysis. *Robust* = detected in ≥ 2 samples, *singleton* = 1, *absent* = 0. |
| Protein summaries | Mean and median abundance among **positive detections only**; pooled Old-Control-ranked Top-10 proteins; independently ranked Female and Male Top-10 lists and their overlap |

**Sex-resolved detection patterns.** A protein is *treatment-reduced* when Control is detected in ≥ 2 samples and the treatment in ≤ 1 (an *exact loss* additionally requires 0). Reduced proteins are divided into mutually exclusive patterns: **shared loss** (reduced after both interventions), **Exercise-specific** (reduced after Exercise but ≥ 2 detections after Rapamycin) and **Rapamycin-specific**. These patterns are **descriptive**: a protein meeting a criterion in only one sex is not, by itself, evidence of a statistically significant Treatment × Sex interaction, and distance from the diagonal in the Female-versus-Male prevalence scatters is not an interaction test.

**How to read the figures.** ER and Ribosome are omitted from the selected multi-bin statistical and effect-size figures and from the combined top-protein plot because each is represented by a single retained protein. They remain in the composition denominator and in the descriptive whole-proteome composition, so the displayed fractions are **not** renormalized. Centered abundance displays subtract each protein's own across-group mean `log10` abundance and must not be used to compare absolute abundance between proteins.

**Outputs.** Everything is written under `Comp_OldTrt/` (`Comp/`, `Stats/`, `Detect/`, `Dots/` and `SexSplit/`); PNG and editable SVG with separate legends. The sex-resolved folder layout is listed in *Sex-resolved output guide*.

> **To run:** keep the two input CSV files (see *Settings*) and the `R/` folder next to this file, then knit. Code is folded by default; use the **Code** buttons to expand it.

## Packages

All packages must be installed beforehand (the script stops and lists any that are missing). Package load order is kept identical to the original analysis because it determines which functions mask which.


## Helper functions

```{r helpers}
# Robust CSV writing. A file that is briefly locked (open in Excel, or being synced by
# Dropbox/OneDrive) makes write.csv fail with "cannot open the connection". Retry a few
# times, then stop with a message that names the file. The written content is unchanged.
write.csv <- function(x, file = "", ...) {
  if (!is.character(file) || identical(file, "")) return(utils::write.csv(x, file = file, ...))
  last_err <- NULL
  for (attempt in 1:5) {
    ok <- tryCatch({ utils::write.csv(x, file = file, ...); TRUE },
                   error = function(e) { last_err <<- conditionMessage(e); FALSE })
    if (ok) return(invisible(NULL))
    Sys.sleep(2)
  }
  stop("Could not write '", file, "' after 5 attempts (", last_err, "). Close the file if it is open ",
       "in Excel, pause Dropbox/OneDrive syncing or move the project to a local folder, then re-run.",
       call. = FALSE)
}

# All figure exports are routed through the self-contained registry in the
# next chunk; the original (plot, filename, width, height, dpi) API is retained.
save_plot_png <- function(plot, file, width, height, dpi = 300) {
  nm_register_and_export(plot, file, width, height)
}

fmt_p <- function(p) {
  dplyr::case_when(is.na(p) ~ "NA", p < 0.001 ~ "<0.001", TRUE ~ sprintf("%.3f", p))
}

fmt_p_detection <- function(p) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(p) ~ "p=NA",
    p < 0.001 ~ "p<0.001*",
    p <= 0.050 ~ paste0("p=", formatC(p, format = "f", digits = 3), "*"),
    TRUE ~ paste0("p=", formatC(p, format = "f", digits = 3))
  )
}
```

# Load data and select old-treatment samples

```{r load-data}
df <- read.csv(intensity_file, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

meta <- read.csv(meta_file, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

required_meta <- c("ID", "Age", "Treatment", "Sex")

missing_meta <- setdiff(required_meta, colnames(meta))

if (length(missing_meta) > 0) {
  stop("Missing metadata columns: ", paste(missing_meta, collapse = ", "))
}

required_df <- c("Protein.Group", "Genes")

missing_df <- setdiff(required_df, colnames(df))

if (length(missing_df) > 0) {
  stop("Missing protein-data columns: ", paste(missing_df, collapse = ", "))
}

meta_old <- meta %>%
  mutate(
    ID = as.character(ID),
    Age = str_to_title(trimws(as.character(Age))),
    Treatment = str_to_title(trimws(as.character(Treatment))),
    Sex = str_to_title(trimws(as.character(Sex)))
  ) %>%
  filter(Age == "Old", Treatment %in% c("Control", "Exercise", "Rapamycin"), ID %in% colnames(df)) %>%
  mutate(
    Treatment = factor(Treatment, levels = c("Control", "Exercise", "Rapamycin")),
    Sex = factor(Sex, levels = c("Female", "Male")),
    Group_3x2 = factor(
      paste(Treatment, Sex, sep = "_"),
      levels = c(
        "Control_Female",
        "Exercise_Female",
        "Rapamycin_Female",
        "Control_Male",
        "Exercise_Male",
        "Rapamycin_Male"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(Sex, Treatment, ID)

if (nrow(meta_old) == 0) {
  stop("No old Control/Exercise/Rapamycin samples were found.")
}

if (any(table(meta_old$Group_3x2) == 0)) {
  warning(
    paste0(
      "At least one Treatment × Sex cell contains zero samples. ",
      "The factorial model may not be estimable."
    )
  )
}

all_cols <- meta_old$ID

cat("Samples included:\n")

print(table(meta_old$Treatment, meta_old$Sex))
```

# Build long-format intensity table

Raw intensities are retained for composition weighting. Zeros and missing values are treated as non-detections with intensity zero.

The first gene symbol in the `Genes` field is used for GO annotation; `Protein.Group` remains the unique protein identity.

```{r long-table}
mat_raw <- df %>%
  select(Protein.Group, Genes, all_of(all_cols)) %>%
  mutate(
    Protein.Group = as.character(Protein.Group),
    Genes = as.character(Genes),
    Gene1 = str_trim(str_remove(Genes, ";.*$")),
    Gene1 = if_else(is.na(Gene1) | Gene1 == "", Protein.Group, Gene1)
  )

long <- mat_raw %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(all_cols), names_to = "Sample", values_to = "Intensity") %>%
  mutate(
    Intensity = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Intensity)),
    Intensity = if_else(is.na(Intensity) | Intensity <= 0, 0, Intensity)
  ) %>%
  left_join(meta_old %>% select(ID, Treatment, Sex, Group_3x2), by = c("Sample" = "ID"))
```

# GO Cellular Component single-bin assignment

```{r go-cc-assignment}
bin_roots <- list(
  "ECM"                 = c("GO:0031012"),
  "Extracellular"       = c("GO:0005576"),
  "Sarcomere/Myofibril" = c("GO:0030017", "GO:0030016", "GO:0043292"),
  "Cytoskeleton"        = c("GO:0005856"),
  "Mitochondrion"       = c("GO:0005739"),
  "Nucleus"             = c("GO:0005634"),
  "Ribosome"            = c("GO:0005840"),
  "ER"                  = c("GO:0005783"),
  "Golgi"               = c("GO:0005794"),
  "Plasma membrane"     = c("GO:0005886"),
  "Endosome/Lysosome"   = c("GO:0005768", "GO:0005764"),
  "Proteasome"          = c("GO:0000502"),
  "Cytosol"             = c("GO:0005829")
)

bin_priority <- names(bin_roots)

go_cc_offspring <- AnnotationDbi::as.list(GO.db::GOCCOFFSPRING)

get_offspring <- function(go_id) {
  kids <- go_cc_offspring[[go_id]]

  unique(c(go_id, kids))
}

bin_terms <- lapply(
  bin_roots,
  function(ids) {
    unique(unlist(lapply(ids, get_offspring), use.names = FALSE))
  }
)

assign_bin <- function(go_vec) {
  go_vec <- unique(go_vec[!is.na(go_vec)])

  if (length(go_vec) == 0) {
    return("Other/Unassigned")
  }

  for (b in bin_priority) {
    if (any(go_vec %in% bin_terms[[b]])) {
      return(b)
    }
  }

  "Other/Unassigned"
}

genes <- sort(unique(na.omit(long$Gene1)))

gene2entrez <- suppressMessages(
  AnnotationDbi::select(org.Mm.eg.db, keys = genes, keytype = "SYMBOL", columns = c("SYMBOL", "ENTREZID"))
) %>%
  distinct(SYMBOL, ENTREZID) %>%
  filter(!is.na(ENTREZID))

entrez2go <- suppressMessages(
  AnnotationDbi::select(
    org.Mm.eg.db,
    keys = sort(unique(gene2entrez$ENTREZID)),
    keytype = "ENTREZID",
    columns = c("ENTREZID", "GO", "ONTOLOGY")
  )
) %>%
  filter(ONTOLOGY == "CC", !is.na(GO)) %>%
  distinct(ENTREZID, GO)

gene_bin <- gene2entrez %>%
  left_join(entrez2go, by = "ENTREZID") %>%
  group_by(SYMBOL) %>%
  summarise(GO_CC = list(unique(GO)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Bin = vapply(GO_CC, assign_bin, character(1)))

long <- long %>%
  left_join(gene_bin %>% select(SYMBOL, Bin), by = c("Gene1" = "SYMBOL")) %>%
  mutate(Bin = if_else(is.na(Bin), "Other/Unassigned", Bin))

write.csv(
  long %>%
    distinct(Protein.Group, Gene1, Bin),
  file.path(out_dir, "Protein_GOCC_bin_assignment.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

long_assigned <- long %>%
  filter(Bin != "Other/Unassigned")

cat("GO-CC assignment before removing unassigned proteins:\n")

print(long %>% distinct(Protein.Group, Bin) %>% count(Bin, sort = TRUE))
```

# Reproducibility filter

A protein is retained if it is detected in at least two samples in **Control OR Exercise OR Rapamycin**.

```{r min2-filter}
keep_proteins <- long_assigned %>%
  mutate(Detected = Intensity > 0) %>%
  group_by(Protein.Group, Treatment) %>%
  summarise(n_detected = sum(Detected, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Protein.Group) %>%
  summarise(keep = any(n_detected >= min_detect_n), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(keep) %>%
  select(Protein.Group)

long_filt <- long_assigned %>%
  semi_join(keep_proteins, by = "Protein.Group")

cat("Assigned proteins before filter: ", n_distinct(long_assigned$Protein.Group), "\n", sep = "")

cat("Proteins after min2 filter: ", n_distinct(long_filt$Protein.Group), "\n", sep = "")

protein_counts_by_bin <- long_filt %>%
  distinct(Protein.Group, Gene1, Bin) %>%
  count(Bin, name = "n_proteins") %>%
  arrange(desc(n_proteins))

write.csv(protein_counts_by_bin, file.path(out_dir, "Protein_counts_by_bin.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

protein_counts_by_bin
```

# Composition calculations

```{r composition-functions}
mass_composition_sample <- function(long_df, group_vars) {

  long_df %>%
    group_by(across(all_of(c(group_vars, "Sample")))) %>%
    mutate(total = sum(Intensity, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    group_by(across(all_of(c(group_vars, "Sample", "Bin")))) %>%
    summarise(Bin_intensity = sum(Intensity, na.rm = TRUE), total = dplyr::first(total), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(
      Fraction = if_else(total > 0, Bin_intensity / total, 0),
      Fraction_pct = Fraction * 100,
      Fraction_asin = asin(sqrt(Fraction))
    )
}

count_composition_sample <- function(long_df, group_vars) {

  sample_meta_local <- long_df %>%
    distinct(across(all_of(c(group_vars, "Sample"))))

  bins_local <- sort(unique(long_df$Bin))

  counts <- long_df %>%
    filter(Intensity > 0) %>%
    distinct(across(all_of(c(group_vars, "Sample", "Protein.Group", "Bin")))) %>%
    count(across(all_of(c(group_vars, "Sample", "Bin"))), name = "n_bin")

  complete_grid <- sample_meta_local %>%
    tidyr::crossing(Bin = bins_local)

  complete_grid %>%
    left_join(counts, by = c(group_vars, "Sample", "Bin")) %>%
    mutate(n_bin = replace_na(n_bin, 0L)) %>%
    group_by(across(all_of(c(group_vars, "Sample")))) %>%
    mutate(total_bin = sum(n_bin, na.rm = TRUE), Fraction = if_else(total_bin > 0, n_bin / total_bin, 0)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(Fraction_pct = Fraction * 100, Fraction_asin = asin(sqrt(Fraction)))
}

summarise_composition <- function(comp_df, group_vars) {

  comp_df %>%
    group_by(across(all_of(c(group_vars, "Bin")))) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_pct = mean(Fraction_pct, na.rm = TRUE),
      sem_pct = sd(Fraction_pct, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
      n = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}
```

# Descriptive composition summaries

These stacked summaries retain all assigned bins, including ER and Ribosome.

```{r descriptive-composition, fig.keep="none"}
all_bins <- sort(unique(long_filt$Bin))

pal <- setNames(viridisLite::viridis(length(all_bins), option = "D", end = 0.95), all_bins)

make_stacked_plot <- function(df_plot, x_var, title, x_levels = NULL, x_labels = NULL) {

  dd <- df_plot %>%
    mutate(Bin = as.character(Bin))

  if (!is.null(x_levels)) {
    dd[[x_var]] <- factor(dd[[x_var]], levels = x_levels)
  }

  bin_order <- dd %>%
    group_by(Bin) %>%
    summarise(contribution = sum(mean_pct, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(desc(contribution)) %>%
    pull(Bin)

  dd <- dd %>%
    mutate(Bin = factor(Bin, levels = bin_order))

  p <- ggplot(dd, aes(x = .data[[x_var]], y = mean_pct, fill = Bin)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.55, colour = "white", linewidth = nm_style$composition_bar_line) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = pal, breaks = bin_order, drop = TRUE, name = "Cellular component") +
    scale_y_continuous(
      labels = function(x) {
        paste0(x, "%")
      },
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))
    ) +
    labs(title = title, x = NULL, y = "Percent of assigned insoluble proteome") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 7),
      legend.position = "right",
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = nm_style$axis_text, face = "bold"),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid = element_blank()
    )

  if (!is.null(x_labels)) {
    p <- p +
      scale_x_discrete(labels = x_labels)
  }

  p
}

# Nested Treatment-within-Sex positions.
# Treatments are close within each sex; a larger gap separates Female and Male.
trt_sex_x <- tibble(
  Treatment = c("Control", "Exercise", "Rapamycin", "Control", "Exercise", "Rapamycin"),
  Sex = c("Female", "Female", "Female", "Male", "Male", "Male"),
  x_pos = c(1.00, 1.40, 1.80, 2.40, 2.80, 3.20)
)

sex_axis_x <- tibble(
  Sex_label = c("Female", "Male"),
  x_start = c(0.85, 2.30),
  x_end = c(1.95, 3.35),
  x_mid = c(1.40, 2.80)
)

make_stacked_3x2_nested <- function(df_plot, title, y_label = "Percent of assigned insoluble proteome") {

  dd <- df_plot %>%
    mutate(Treatment = as.character(Treatment), Sex = as.character(Sex), Bin = as.character(Bin)) %>%
    left_join(trt_sex_x, by = c("Treatment", "Sex"))

  bin_order <- dd %>%
    group_by(Bin) %>%
    summarise(contribution = sum(mean_pct, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(desc(contribution)) %>%
    pull(Bin)

  dd <- dd %>%
    mutate(Bin = factor(Bin, levels = bin_order))

  y_max <- dd %>%
    group_by(Treatment, Sex) %>%
    summarise(group_total = sum(mean_pct, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    summarise(y_max = max(group_total, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    pull(y_max)

  if (!is.finite(y_max) || y_max <= 0) {
    y_max <- 100
  }

  sex_ann <- sex_axis_x %>%
    mutate(y_line = -0.070 * y_max, y_text = -0.125 * y_max)

  ggplot(dd, aes(x = x_pos, y = mean_pct, fill = Bin)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.34, colour = "white", linewidth = nm_style$composition_bar_line) +
    geom_segment(
      data = sex_ann,
      aes(x = x_start, xend = x_end, y = y_line, yend = y_line),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      linewidth = nm_style$composition_axis_divider,
      colour = "grey35"
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = sex_ann,
      aes(x = x_mid, y = y_text, label = Sex_label),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      size = nm_style$composition_sex_label,
      fontface = "bold",
      colour = "grey25"
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = pal, breaks = bin_order, drop = TRUE, name = "Cellular component") +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = trt_sex_x$x_pos,
      labels = c("Ctl", "Ex", "Rapa", "Ctl", "Ex", "Rapa"),
      limits = c(0.65, 3.50),
      expand = expansion(mult = 0)
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      labels = function(x) {
        paste0(x, "%")
      },
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, y_max * 1.02), clip = "off") +
    labs(title = title, x = NULL, y = y_label) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
      legend.position = "right",
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = nm_style$axis_text, face = "bold", margin = margin(t = 5)),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      plot.margin = margin(t = 5, r = 5, b = 38, l = 5)
    )
}
```

# Bin-level statistics

## Statistical model

For each cellular-component bin, abundance-weighted per-sample fractions are arcsine-square-root transformed before inference.

The treatment-only analysis uses:

`Fraction_asin ~ Treatment`

The factorial analysis uses:

`Fraction_asin ~ Treatment * Sex`

For the factorial model, Type III F tests with sum-to-zero contrasts are used so that Treatment and Sex main effects are tested in the presence of the Treatment × Sex interaction. FDR is calculated separately across bins for Treatment, Sex, and Treatment × Sex.

```{r bin-statistics}
test_one_bin_treatment <- function(df_bin) {

  out <- tibble(p_Treatment = NA_real_)

  if (nrow(df_bin) < 4 || length(unique(df_bin$Fraction)) < 2) {
    return(out)
  }

  fit <- tryCatch(lm(Fraction_asin ~ Treatment, data = df_bin), error = function(e) NULL)

  if (is.null(fit)) {
    return(out)
  }

  an <- tryCatch(anova(fit), error = function(e) NULL)

  if (is.null(an)) {
    return(out)
  }

  tibble(
    p_Treatment = if ("Treatment" %in% rownames(an)) {
      an["Treatment", "Pr(>F)"]
    } else {
      NA_real_
    }
  )
}

test_one_bin_3x2 <- function(df_bin) {

  out <- tibble(p_Treatment = NA_real_, p_Sex = NA_real_, p_TreatmentSex = NA_real_)

  if (nrow(df_bin) < 4 || length(unique(df_bin$Fraction)) < 2) {
    return(out)
  }

  dd <- df_bin %>%
    mutate(
      Treatment = droplevels(factor(Treatment, levels = c("Control", "Exercise", "Rapamycin"))),
      Sex = droplevels(factor(Sex, levels = c("Female", "Male")))
    )

  if (nlevels(dd$Treatment) < 2 || nlevels(dd$Sex) < 2) {
    return(out)
  }

  contrasts(dd$Treatment) <- contr.sum(nlevels(dd$Treatment))

  contrasts(dd$Sex) <- contr.sum(nlevels(dd$Sex))

  fit <- tryCatch(lm(Fraction_asin ~ Treatment * Sex, data = dd), error = function(e) NULL)

  if (is.null(fit)) {
    return(out)
  }

  an <- tryCatch(car::Anova(fit, type = 3), error = function(e) NULL)

  if (is.null(an)) {
    return(out)
  }

  tibble(
    p_Treatment = if ("Treatment" %in% rownames(an)) {
      an["Treatment", "Pr(>F)"]
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },

    p_Sex = if ("Sex" %in% rownames(an)) {
      an["Sex", "Pr(>F)"]
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },

    p_TreatmentSex = if ("Treatment:Sex" %in% rownames(an)) {
      an["Treatment:Sex", "Pr(>F)"]
    } else {
      NA_real_
    }
  )
}

run_bin_stats_treatment <- function(comp_df) {

  p_tbl <- comp_df %>%
    group_by(Bin) %>%
    group_modify(~ test_one_bin_treatment(.x)) %>%
    ungroup()

  means_tbl <- comp_df %>%
    group_by(Bin, Treatment) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_pct = mean(Fraction_pct, na.rm = TRUE),
      sem_pct = sd(Fraction_pct, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
      n = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Treatment, values_from = c(mean_pct, sem_pct, n)) %>%
    mutate(
      delta_Exercise_minus_Control =
        mean_pct_Exercise -
        mean_pct_Control,

      delta_Rapamycin_minus_Control =
        mean_pct_Rapamycin -
        mean_pct_Control
    )

  p_tbl %>%
    left_join(means_tbl, by = "Bin") %>%
    mutate(FDR_Treatment = p.adjust(p_Treatment, method = "BH")) %>%
    arrange(FDR_Treatment)
}

run_bin_stats_3x2 <- function(comp_df) {

  p_tbl <- comp_df %>%
    group_by(Bin) %>%
    group_modify(~ test_one_bin_3x2(.x)) %>%
    ungroup()

  means_group <- comp_df %>%
    mutate(Group = paste(Treatment, Sex, sep = "_")) %>%
    group_by(Bin, Group) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_pct = mean(Fraction_pct, na.rm = TRUE),
      sem_pct = sd(Fraction_pct, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
      n = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Group, values_from = c(mean_pct, sem_pct, n))

  p_tbl %>%
    left_join(means_group, by = "Bin") %>%
    mutate(
      FDR_Treatment = p.adjust(p_Treatment, method = "BH"),
      FDR_Sex = p.adjust(p_Sex, method = "BH"),
      FDR_TreatmentSex = p.adjust(p_TreatmentSex, method = "BH")
    ) %>%
    arrange(FDR_Treatment, FDR_Sex, FDR_TreatmentSex)
}
```

```{r planned-composition-contrasts}
# ==============================================================================
# Planned treatment contrasts from the full six-group model
#
# All six Treatment × Sex groups are fitted simultaneously.
#
# Primary treatment contrasts:
#   Ex   = average Exercise - Control effect across Female and Male
#   Rapa = average Rapamycin - Control effect across Female and Male
#
# Treatment-specific Sex interactions:
#   Ex:Sex =
#     (Exercise - Control)_Male -
#     (Exercise - Control)_Female
#
#   Rapa:Sex =
#     (Rapamycin - Control)_Male -
#     (Rapamycin - Control)_Female
#
# For composition, the response is Fraction_asin.
# For summed raw abundance later in the report, the same function is reused
# with Log2_raw_sum.
# ==============================================================================

fit_planned_contrasts_one_bin <- function(df_bin, response_col) {

  empty_out <- tibble(
  Estimate_Ex = NA_real_,
  SE_Ex = NA_real_,
  p_Ex = NA_real_,

  Estimate_ExSex = NA_real_,
  SE_ExSex = NA_real_,
  p_ExSex = NA_real_,

  Estimate_Rapa = NA_real_,
  SE_Rapa = NA_real_,
  p_Rapa = NA_real_,

  Estimate_RapaSex = NA_real_,
  SE_RapaSex = NA_real_,
  p_RapaSex = NA_real_,

  # Within-sex simple/posthoc contrasts
  p_Ex_Female = NA_real_,
  p_Ex_Male = NA_real_,
  p_Rapa_Female = NA_real_,
  p_Rapa_Male = NA_real_
)

  dd <- df_bin %>%
    mutate(
      Response = .data[[response_col]],

      Group = factor(
        paste(as.character(Treatment), as.character(Sex), sep = "_"),
        levels = c(
          "Control_Female",
          "Exercise_Female",
          "Rapamycin_Female",
          "Control_Male",
          "Exercise_Male",
          "Rapamycin_Male"
        )
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(is.finite(Response), !is.na(Group))

  if (nrow(dd) < 6 || nlevels(droplevels(dd$Group)) < 6) {
    return(empty_out)
  }

  fit <- tryCatch(lm(Response ~ 0 + Group, data = dd), error = function(e) NULL)

  if (is.null(fit)) {
    return(empty_out)
  }

  b <- coef(fit)

  V <- vcov(fit)

  df_res <- df.residual(fit)

  coef_names <- names(b)

  contrast_test <- function(weights) {

    if (!all(names(weights) %in% coef_names)) {
      return(c(Estimate = NA_real_, SE = NA_real_, p = NA_real_))
    }

    cvec <- rep(0, length(b))

    names(cvec) <- coef_names

    cvec[names(weights)] <- weights

    estimate <- sum(cvec * b)

    se <- sqrt(as.numeric(t(cvec) %*% V %*% cvec))

    if (!is.finite(se) || se <= 0) {
      return(c(Estimate = estimate, SE = se, p = NA_real_))
    }

    t_stat <-
      estimate /
      se

    p_val <-
      2 *
      pt(-abs(t_stat), df = df_res)

    c(Estimate = estimate, SE = se, p = p_val)
  }

  ex <- contrast_test(
    c(
      "GroupControl_Female" = -0.5,
      "GroupExercise_Female" = 0.5,
      "GroupControl_Male" = -0.5,
      "GroupExercise_Male" = 0.5
    )
  )

  ex_sex <- contrast_test(
    c("GroupControl_Female" = 1, "GroupExercise_Female" = -1, "GroupControl_Male" = -1, "GroupExercise_Male" = 1)
  )

  rapa <- contrast_test(
    c(
      "GroupControl_Female" = -0.5,
      "GroupRapamycin_Female" = 0.5,
      "GroupControl_Male" = -0.5,
      "GroupRapamycin_Male" = 0.5
    )
  )

  rapa_sex <- contrast_test(
    c("GroupControl_Female" = 1, "GroupRapamycin_Female" = -1, "GroupControl_Male" = -1, "GroupRapamycin_Male" = 1)
  )

  # ==============================================================================
# Within-sex simple/posthoc treatment contrasts
#
# These are the p-values that will be displayed above the exact groups when
# the corresponding Treatment × Sex interaction is significant.
# ==============================================================================

ex_female <- contrast_test(c("GroupControl_Female" = -1, "GroupExercise_Female" = 1))

ex_male <- contrast_test(c("GroupControl_Male" = -1, "GroupExercise_Male" = 1))

rapa_female <- contrast_test(c("GroupControl_Female" = -1, "GroupRapamycin_Female" = 1))

rapa_male <- contrast_test(c("GroupControl_Male" = -1, "GroupRapamycin_Male" = 1))

  tibble(
    Estimate_Ex =
      unname(ex["Estimate"]),

    SE_Ex =
      unname(ex["SE"]),

    p_Ex =
      unname(ex["p"]),

    Estimate_ExSex =
      unname(ex_sex["Estimate"]),

    SE_ExSex =
      unname(ex_sex["SE"]),

    p_ExSex =
      unname(ex_sex["p"]),

    Estimate_Rapa =
      unname(rapa["Estimate"]),

    SE_Rapa =
      unname(rapa["SE"]),

    p_Rapa =
      unname(rapa["p"]),

    Estimate_RapaSex =
      unname(rapa_sex["Estimate"]),

    SE_RapaSex =
      unname(rapa_sex["SE"]),

    p_RapaSex =
  unname(rapa_sex["p"]),

p_Ex_Female =
  unname(ex_female["p"]),

p_Ex_Male =
  unname(ex_male["p"]),

p_Rapa_Female =
  unname(rapa_female["p"]),

p_Rapa_Male =
  unname(rapa_male["p"])
  )
}

run_planned_contrasts_by_bin <- function(df, response_col) {

  df %>%
    filter(Bin %in% bin_order_figure, !Bin %in% bins_to_remove_display) %>%
    group_by(Bin) %>%
    group_modify(~ fit_planned_contrasts_one_bin(.x, response_col)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      FDR_Ex = p.adjust(p_Ex, method = "BH"),

      FDR_ExSex = p.adjust(p_ExSex, method = "BH"),

      FDR_Rapa = p.adjust(p_Rapa, method = "BH"),

      FDR_RapaSex = p.adjust(p_RapaSex, method = "BH")
    ) %>%
    arrange(match(as.character(Bin), bin_order_figure))
}

mass_planned_stats <- run_planned_contrasts_by_bin(mass_sample_3x2, "Fraction_asin")

write.csv(mass_planned_stats, file.path(stats_dir, "BinStats_mass_PlannedContrasts.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

mass_planned_stats
```

# Final abundance-weighted Treatment × Sex composition figure

This plot shows each sample and the group mean ± SEM. The facet headers report prespecified contrasts from the full six-group Treatment × Sex model: the sex-averaged Exercise-versus-Control and Rapamycin-versus-Control effects and their treatment-specific Sex interactions. BH-FDR is calculated separately across cellular-component bins for Ex, Ex:Sex, Rapa, and Rapa:Sex. ER and Ribosome are omitted from this display. Each cellular-component panel retains its own data-driven y-axis range.

```{r final-3x2-figure, fig.keep="none"}
bin_order_pvals <- bin_order_figure[bin_order_figure %in% unique(as.character(mass_sample_3x2$Bin))]

plot_df_3x2 <- mass_sample_3x2 %>%
  filter(!Bin %in% bins_to_remove_display, Bin %in% bin_order_pvals) %>%
  left_join(
    mass_planned_stats %>%
  filter(!Bin %in% bins_to_remove_display, Bin %in% bin_order_pvals) %>%
  select(
    Bin,

    p_Ex,
    p_ExSex,

    p_Rapa,
    p_RapaSex,

    FDR_Ex,
    FDR_Rapa,

    # exact within-sex posthoc p-values
    p_Ex_Female,
    p_Ex_Male,
    p_Rapa_Female,
    p_Rapa_Male
  ),
    by = "Bin"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Treatment_chr = as.character(Treatment),
    Sex_chr = as.character(Sex),

    x_pos = case_when(
      Treatment_chr == "Control" &
        Sex_chr == "Female" ~ 1.00,

      Treatment_chr == "Exercise" &
        Sex_chr == "Female" ~ 1.30,

      Treatment_chr == "Rapamycin" &
        Sex_chr == "Female" ~ 1.60,

      Treatment_chr == "Control" &
        Sex_chr == "Male" ~ 2.20,

      Treatment_chr == "Exercise" &
        Sex_chr == "Male" ~ 2.50,

      Treatment_chr == "Rapamycin" &
        Sex_chr == "Male" ~ 2.80
    ),

    Bin = factor(as.character(Bin), levels = bin_order_pvals),

    Bin_lab = paste0(
      "<b><span style='font-size:7pt;'>",
      as.character(Bin),
      "</span></b><br>",

      "<span style='font-size:7pt;'>",
      "Raw: Ex=",
      fmt_p(p_Ex),
      " | Rapa=",
      fmt_p(p_Rapa),
      "</span><br>",

      "<span style='font-size:7pt;'>",
      "FDR: Ex=",
      fmt_p(FDR_Ex),
      " | Rapa=",
      fmt_p(FDR_Rapa),
      "</span>"
    )
  )

bin_lab_order <- plot_df_3x2 %>%
  distinct(Bin, Bin_lab) %>%
  arrange(Bin) %>%
  pull(Bin_lab)

plot_df_3x2 <- plot_df_3x2 %>%
  mutate(Bin_lab = factor(Bin_lab, levels = bin_lab_order))

# ==============================================================================
# Within-sex posthoc brackets for significant Treatment × Sex interactions
#
# Logic:
#
# 1. First require a nominally significant treatment-specific Sex interaction.
# 2. Then inspect the corresponding within-sex simple/posthoc contrasts.
# 3. Draw a bracket only for a within-sex contrast with raw posthoc p <= 0.05.
#
# Example:
#   Ex×Sex significant in Nucleus
#   Female Ex vs Control posthoc significant
#       -> bracket Female Ctl ── Ex with exact posthoc p-value
# ==============================================================================

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Panel ranges
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

panel_ranges_3x2 <- plot_df_3x2 %>%
  group_by(Bin, Bin_lab) %>%
  summarise(y_min = min(Fraction_pct, na.rm = TRUE), y_max = max(Fraction_pct, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# One copy of the statistical results per component
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

posthoc_stats_3x2 <- plot_df_3x2 %>%
  distinct(Bin, Bin_lab, p_ExSex, p_RapaSex, p_Ex_Female, p_Ex_Male, p_Rapa_Female, p_Rapa_Male)

# ==============================================================================
# Exercise × Sex follow-up comparisons
# ==============================================================================

# Female Control vs Exercise
ann_ex_female <- posthoc_stats_3x2 %>%
  filter(!is.na(p_ExSex), p_ExSex <= 0.05, !is.na(p_Ex_Female), p_Ex_Female <= 0.05) %>%

  transmute(
    Bin,
    Bin_lab,

    Comparison =
      "Exercise",

    Sex =
      "Female",

    p_posthoc =
      p_Ex_Female,

    x_start =
      1.00,

    x_end =
      1.30
  )

# Male Control vs Exercise
ann_ex_male <- posthoc_stats_3x2 %>%
  filter(!is.na(p_ExSex), p_ExSex <= 0.05, !is.na(p_Ex_Male), p_Ex_Male <= 0.05) %>%

  transmute(
    Bin,
    Bin_lab,

    Comparison =
      "Exercise",

    Sex =
      "Male",

    p_posthoc =
      p_Ex_Male,

    x_start =
      2.20,

    x_end =
      2.50
  )

# ==============================================================================
# Rapamycin × Sex follow-up comparisons
# ==============================================================================

# Female Control vs Rapamycin
ann_rapa_female <- posthoc_stats_3x2 %>%
  filter(!is.na(p_RapaSex), p_RapaSex <= 0.05, !is.na(p_Rapa_Female), p_Rapa_Female <= 0.05) %>%

  transmute(
    Bin,
    Bin_lab,

    Comparison =
      "Rapamycin",

    Sex =
      "Female",

    p_posthoc =
      p_Rapa_Female,

    x_start =
      1.00,

    x_end =
      1.60
  )

# Male Control vs Rapamycin
ann_rapa_male <- posthoc_stats_3x2 %>%
  filter(!is.na(p_RapaSex), p_RapaSex <= 0.05, !is.na(p_Rapa_Male), p_Rapa_Male <= 0.05) %>%

  transmute(
    Bin,
    Bin_lab,

    Comparison =
      "Rapamycin",

    Sex =
      "Male",

    p_posthoc =
      p_Rapa_Male,

    x_start =
      2.20,

    x_end =
      2.80
  )

# ==============================================================================
# Combine annotations
# ==============================================================================

posthoc_ann_3x2 <- bind_rows(ann_ex_female, ann_ex_male, ann_rapa_female, ann_rapa_male) %>%

  left_join(panel_ranges_3x2, by = c("Bin", "Bin_lab")) %>%

  group_by(Bin, Bin_lab) %>%

  arrange(Sex, Comparison, .by_group = TRUE) %>%

  mutate(
    annotation_level =
      row_number(),

    y_range = pmax(y_max - y_min, 0.08 * abs(y_max), 1e-6),

    # bracket height
    y_bracket =
      y_max +
      (0.10 + 0.16 * (annotation_level - 1)) *
      y_range,

    # short downward ticks
    y_tick =
      y_bracket -
      0.035 *
      y_range,

    # p-value position
    y_label =
      y_bracket +
      0.025 *
      y_range,

    x_mid =
      (x_start + x_end) /
      2,

    p_label =
      paste0("p=", fmt_p(p_posthoc))
  ) %>%

  ungroup()

# Only the bottom row receives the nested Sex axis annotations.
bottom_bins <- tail(bin_order_pvals, 4)

bottom_bin_labs <- plot_df_3x2 %>%
  filter(as.character(Bin) %in% bottom_bins) %>%
  distinct(Bin_lab) %>%
  pull(Bin_lab)
```

# Effect-size analyses

Two effect-size definitions are retained:

1. **Percentage-point effect:** Exercise − Control or Rapamycin − Control in the percentage of the total insoluble proteome assigned to each bin.
2. **Within-bin relative change:** `100 × (Treatment − Control) / Control`, describing the relative change in that component's contribution compared with Old Control.

Both sexes-combined and sex-specific versions are exported. For the sex-specific figures, 95% confidence intervals are added. Percentage-point differences are estimated as linear contrasts on the displayed percentage scale; confidence intervals for within-component relative percent changes are obtained by the delta method. These effect-size intervals are descriptive complements to the primary planned-contrast inference performed on arcsine-square-root transformed fractions.

```{r effect-size-data}

display_bins <- bin_order_figure[bin_order_figure %in% unique(mass_stats_treatment$Bin)]

comparison_levels <- c("Exercise - Control", "Rapamycin - Control")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Existing sex-combined descriptive effect estimates are retained.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

effect_overall <- mass_stats_treatment %>%
  filter(Bin %in% display_bins, !Bin %in% bins_to_remove_display) %>%
  select(Bin, p_Treatment, FDR_Treatment, delta_Exercise_minus_Control, delta_Rapamycin_minus_Control) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(delta_Exercise_minus_Control, delta_Rapamycin_minus_Control),
    names_to = "Effect",
    values_to = "delta_pp"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Comparison = case_when(
      Effect == "delta_Exercise_minus_Control" ~
        "Exercise - Control",
      Effect == "delta_Rapamycin_minus_Control" ~
        "Rapamycin - Control",
      TRUE ~ Effect
    ),
    Comparison = factor(Comparison, levels = comparison_levels),
    Bin = factor(as.character(Bin), levels = rev(display_bins))
  )

within_overall <- mass_stats_treatment %>%
  filter(Bin %in% display_bins, !Bin %in% bins_to_remove_display) %>%
  transmute(
    Bin,
    p_Treatment,
    FDR_Treatment,

    Ex = if_else(
      !is.na(mean_pct_Control) &
        mean_pct_Control > 0,
      100 *
        (mean_pct_Exercise - mean_pct_Control) /
        mean_pct_Control,
      NA_real_
    ),

    Rapa = if_else(
      !is.na(mean_pct_Control) &
        mean_pct_Control > 0,
      100 *
        (mean_pct_Rapamycin - mean_pct_Control) /
        mean_pct_Control,
      NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Ex, Rapa), names_to = "Effect", values_to = "withinbin_pct_change") %>%
  mutate(
    Comparison = dplyr::recode(Effect, Ex = "Exercise - Control", Rapa = "Rapamycin - Control"),
    Comparison = factor(Comparison, levels = comparison_levels),
    Bin = factor(as.character(Bin), levels = rev(display_bins))
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Sex-specific effect-size estimation on the displayed percentage scale
#
# A six-group model is fitted for Fraction_pct.
#
# Percentage-point effect:
#   Treatment mean - Control mean
#
# Within-component relative effect:
#   100 × (Treatment mean / Control mean - 1)
#
# Percentage-point CIs are exact linear-contrast CIs from this model.
# Relative-change CIs use the delta method with the same model covariance matrix.
#
# Hypothesis-test p-values shown in the 3x2 facet headers remain those from the
# primary arcsine-square-root transformed planned-contrast model.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

estimate_composition_effects_one_bin <- function(df_bin) {

  empty_out <- tidyr::crossing(
    Comparison = c("Exercise - Control", "Rapamycin - Control"),
    Sex = c("Female", "Male")
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      delta_pp = NA_real_,
      SE_pp = NA_real_,
      CI_low_pp = NA_real_,
      CI_high_pp = NA_real_,
      withinbin_pct_change = NA_real_,
      SE_relative = NA_real_,
      CI_low_relative = NA_real_,
      CI_high_relative = NA_real_
    )

  dd <- df_bin %>%
    mutate(
      Group = factor(
        paste(as.character(Treatment), as.character(Sex), sep = "_"),
        levels = c(
          "Control_Female",
          "Exercise_Female",
          "Rapamycin_Female",
          "Control_Male",
          "Exercise_Male",
          "Rapamycin_Male"
        )
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(is.finite(Fraction_pct), !is.na(Group))

  if (nlevels(droplevels(dd$Group)) < 6) {
    return(empty_out)
  }

  fit <- tryCatch(lm(Fraction_pct ~ 0 + Group, data = dd), error = function(e) NULL)

  if (is.null(fit)) {
    return(empty_out)
  }

  b <- coef(fit)

  V <- vcov(fit)

  df_res <- df.residual(fit)

  coef_names <- names(b)

  get_effect <- function(compare_trt, sex_name) {

    ctl_name <- paste0("GroupControl_", sex_name)

    trt_name <- paste0("Group", compare_trt, "_", sex_name)

    comparison_name <- paste0(compare_trt, " - Control")

    if (!all(c(ctl_name, trt_name) %in% coef_names)) {
      return(empty_out %>% filter(Comparison == comparison_name, Sex == sex_name))
    }

    # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Percentage-point difference
    # --------------------------------------------------------------------------

    cvec <- rep(0, length(b))

    names(cvec) <- coef_names

    cvec[trt_name] <- 1

    cvec[ctl_name] <- -1

    delta_pp <- sum(cvec * b)

    se_pp <- sqrt(as.numeric(t(cvec) %*% V %*% cvec))

    tcrit <- qt(0.975, df = df_res)

    ci_low_pp <-
      delta_pp -
      tcrit *
        se_pp

    ci_high_pp <-
      delta_pp +
      tcrit *
        se_pp

    # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Within-component relative percent change
    #
    # f(mu_trt, mu_ctl) =
    #   100 × (mu_trt / mu_ctl - 1)
    #
    # SE is estimated with the delta method.
    # --------------------------------------------------------------------------

    mu_ctl <- unname(b[ctl_name])

    mu_trt <- unname(b[trt_name])

    if (!is.finite(mu_ctl) || mu_ctl <= 0 || !is.finite(mu_trt)) {

      relative_change <- NA_real_
      se_relative <- NA_real_
      ci_low_relative <- NA_real_
      ci_high_relative <- NA_real_

    } else {

      relative_change <-
        100 *
        (mu_trt / mu_ctl - 1)

      grad <- rep(0, length(b))

      names(grad) <- coef_names

      grad[trt_name] <-
        100 /
        mu_ctl

      grad[ctl_name] <-
        -100 *
        mu_trt /
        (mu_ctl^2)

      se_relative <- sqrt(as.numeric(t(grad) %*% V %*% grad))

      ci_low_relative <-
        relative_change -
        tcrit *
          se_relative

      ci_high_relative <-
        relative_change +
        tcrit *
          se_relative
    }

    tibble(
      Comparison =
        comparison_name,

      Sex =
        sex_name,

      delta_pp =
        delta_pp,

      SE_pp =
        se_pp,

      CI_low_pp =
        ci_low_pp,

      CI_high_pp =
        ci_high_pp,

      withinbin_pct_change =
        relative_change,

      SE_relative =
        se_relative,

      CI_low_relative =
        ci_low_relative,

      CI_high_relative =
        ci_high_relative
    )
  }

  bind_rows(
    get_effect("Exercise", "Female"),

    get_effect("Exercise", "Male"),

    get_effect("Rapamycin", "Female"),

    get_effect("Rapamycin", "Male")
  )
}

composition_effects_by_sex <- mass_sample_3x2 %>%
  filter(Bin %in% display_bins, !Bin %in% bins_to_remove_display) %>%
  group_by(Bin) %>%
  group_modify(~ estimate_composition_effects_one_bin(.x)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    Comparison = factor(Comparison, levels = comparison_levels),

    Sex = factor(Sex, levels = c("Female", "Male"))
  )

effect_by_sex <- composition_effects_by_sex %>%
  transmute(Bin, Comparison, Sex, delta_pp, SE = SE_pp, CI_low = CI_low_pp, CI_high = CI_high_pp)

within_by_sex <- composition_effects_by_sex %>%
  transmute(
    Bin,
    Comparison,
    Sex,
    withinbin_pct_change,
    SE = SE_relative,
    CI_low = CI_low_relative,
    CI_high = CI_high_relative
  )

write.csv(effect_overall, file.path(stats_dir, "Effect_percentagePoint_overall.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

write.csv(effect_by_sex, file.path(stats_dir, "Effect_percentagePoint_bySex.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

write.csv(within_overall, file.path(stats_dir, "Effect_withinBin_overall.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

write.csv(within_by_sex, file.path(stats_dir, "Effect_withinBin_bySex.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

## Percentage-point effects

```{r percentage-point-effects, fig.keep="none"}

bin_colors_display <- pal[display_bins]

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Sex-combined descriptive figure retained
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

x_pp_overall <- effect_overall$delta_pp

x_pp_overall <- x_pp_overall[is.finite(x_pp_overall)]

}

x_pp_overall_lim <- max(abs(x_pp_overall), na.rm = TRUE) * 1.10

p_effect_overall <- ggplot(effect_overall, aes(x = delta_pp, y = Bin, colour = Bin)) +

  geom_vline(linewidth = nm_style$effect_zero_line, xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey60") +

  geom_point(size = nm_style$effect_overall_point) +

  facet_wrap(~ Comparison, nrow = 1) +

  scale_colour_manual(
    values = bin_colors_display,

    name = "Cellular component"
  ) +

  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-x_pp_overall_lim, x_pp_overall_lim)) +

  labs(
    title =
      "Old-treatment effects on insoluble proteome composition",
    x =
      "Difference in percent of total insoluble abundance",
    y = NULL
  ) +

  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +

  theme(strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Sex-specific figure with 95% CI — matched to summed raw-abundance style
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

effect_pp_plot_df <- effect_by_sex %>%
  filter(is.finite(delta_pp), is.finite(CI_low), is.finite(CI_high)) %>%
  mutate(
    Bin_chr =

      match(Bin_chr, rev(display_bins)),

effect_pp_xlim <- max(abs(c(effect_pp_plot_df$CI_low, effect_pp_plot_df$CI_high)), na.rm = TRUE)

  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey60", linewidth = nm_style$effect_zero_line) +

  geom_segment(
    aes(x = CI_low, xend = CI_high, y = y_pos, yend = y_pos),
    linewidth = nm_style$effect_ci_line,
    alpha = 0.90
  ) +

  geom_point(aes(x = delta_pp, y = y_pos, shape = Sex), size = nm_style$effect_point, alpha = 0.95) +

      rev(display_bins),

    expand =
      expansion(mult = 0)
  ) +

  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-effect_pp_xlim, effect_pp_xlim)) +

  labs(
    title =
      "Treatment effects on insoluble proteome composition",

    subtitle =
      "Treatment vs Control within each sex; percentage-point difference with 95% CI",

    x =
      "Difference in percent of total insoluble abundance",

    y = NULL
  ) +

  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +

  theme(
    plot.title =
```

## Summed raw insoluble abundance by cellular component

This analysis complements relative composition by asking whether the **total summed raw insoluble abundance** assigned to each cellular component changes across Control, Exercise, and Rapamycin groups. Raw intensities are summed within each sample × cellular-component bin using the same filtered GO-bin protein universe used for the relative-composition analysis.

The displayed values remain on the raw abundance scale (A.U.). For inference, summed abundance is log2-transformed after addition of a small data-derived pseudocount to accommodate any zero-sum bin × sample combinations.

The factorial model is:

`Log2_raw_sum ~ Treatment * Sex`

where all six Treatment × Sex groups are retained in one model. Prespecified contrasts test the sex-averaged Exercise-versus-Control and Rapamycin-versus-Control effects and the corresponding treatment-specific Sex interactions. BH-FDR correction is applied separately across displayed bins for Ex, Ex:Sex, Rapa, and Rapa:Sex. Sex-specific Exercise-versus-Control and Rapamycin-versus-Control effect sizes are estimated from the same six-group dataset and reported as log2 fold-changes with 95% confidence intervals.

```{r raw-summed-abundance-data}
# ==============================================================================
# Per-sample summed raw abundance
# ==============================================================================

rawsum_sample <- long_filt %>%
  group_by(Treatment, Sex, Sample, Bin) %>%
  summarise(Raw_sum = sum(Intensity, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    Treatment = factor(Treatment, levels = c("Control", "Exercise", "Rapamycin")),
    Sex = factor(Sex, levels = c("Female", "Male"))
  )

# Small data-derived pseudocount used only for the log2 transformation.
min_positive_rawsum <- suppressWarnings(min(rawsum_sample$Raw_sum[rawsum_sample$Raw_sum > 0], na.rm = TRUE))

if (!is.finite(min_positive_rawsum)) {
  stop("Could not identify a positive summed raw abundance.")
}

rawsum_pseudocount <- min_positive_rawsum / 2

rawsum_sample <- rawsum_sample %>%
  mutate(Log2_raw_sum = log2(Raw_sum + rawsum_pseudocount))

write.csv(rawsum_sample, file.path(stats_dir, "RawSum_perSample_allTreatments.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

cat("Raw-sum log2 pseudocount: ", signif(rawsum_pseudocount, 5), "\n", sep = "")
```

```{r raw-summed-abundance-statistics}

# ==============================================================================
# Planned contrasts from the full six-group model
#
# Response:
#   Log2_raw_sum
#
# Same contrast definitions used for relative composition:
#
#   Ex      = sex-averaged Exercise - Control
#   Ex:Sex  = (Exercise - Control)_Male -
#             (Exercise - Control)_Female
#
#   Rapa    = sex-averaged Rapamycin - Control
#   Rapa:Sex= (Rapamycin - Control)_Male -
#             (Rapamycin - Control)_Female
#
# BH-FDR is calculated separately across bins for each of the four planned
# contrast families.
# ==============================================================================

rawsum_planned_stats <- run_planned_contrasts_by_bin(rawsum_sample, "Log2_raw_sum")

write.csv(rawsum_planned_stats, file.path(stats_dir, "RawSum_PlannedContrasts_stats.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

rawsum_planned_stats
```

```{r raw-summed-abundance-3x2-plot, fig.keep="none"}
    # --------------------------------------------------------------------------

# ==============================================================================
# Significant Treatment × Sex interaction annotations
#
# Ex×Sex:
#   spans Female Control/Exercise through Male Control/Exercise
#
# Rapa×Sex:
#   spans Female Control/Rapamycin through Male Control/Rapamycin
#
# Only raw p <= 0.05 interactions are drawn.

interaction_base_rawsum <- plot_rawsum_3x2 %>%
  group_by(Bin, Bin_lab) %>%

  summarise(
    p_ExSex =
      dplyr::first(p_ExSex),

    p_RapaSex =
      dplyr::first(p_RapaSex),

    y_min =
      min(Raw_sum, na.rm = TRUE),

    y_max =
      max(Raw_sum, na.rm = TRUE),

    .groups =
      "drop"
  ) %>%

  mutate(
    # Data-driven scale for annotation height.
    y_range = pmax(y_max - y_min, 0.10 * abs(y_max), 1e-8)
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Exercise × Sex
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

interaction_ex_rawsum <- interaction_base_rawsum %>%
  filter(!is.na(p_ExSex), p_ExSex <= 0.05) %>%

  transmute(
    Bin,
    Bin_lab,
    y_max,
    y_range,

    Interaction =
      "Ex×Sex",

    p_value =
      p_ExSex,

    # Includes:
    # Female Ctl / Ex and Male Ctl / Ex
    x_start =
      1.00,

    x_end =
      2.50
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Rapamycin × Sex
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

interaction_rapa_rawsum <- interaction_base_rawsum %>%
  filter(!is.na(p_RapaSex), p_RapaSex <= 0.05) %>%

  transmute(
    Bin,
    Bin_lab,
    y_max,
    y_range,

    Interaction =
      "Rapa×Sex",

    p_value =
      p_RapaSex,

    # Includes:
    # Female Ctl / Rapa and Male Ctl / Rapa
    x_start =
      1.00,

    x_end =
      2.80
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Combine and stack if both interactions occur in the same component
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

interaction_ann_rawsum <- bind_rows(interaction_ex_rawsum, interaction_rapa_rawsum) %>%

  group_by(Bin, Bin_lab) %>%

  arrange(Interaction, .by_group = TRUE) %>%

  mutate(
    interaction_level =
      row_number(),

    # First interaction sits just above the data.
    # Second interaction, if present, is stacked above it.
    y_line =
      y_max +
      (0.10 + 0.18 * (interaction_level - 1)) *
      y_range,

    y_tick =
      y_line -
      0.040 *
      y_range,

    y_text =
      y_line +
      0.035 *
      y_range,

    x_text =
      (x_start + x_end) /
      2,

    interaction_label =
      paste0(Interaction, " p=", fmt_p(p_value))
  ) %>%

  ungroup()

# ==============================================================================
# Female / Male nested-axis annotations
```

### Treatment effect sizes on summed insoluble abundance

```{r raw-summed-abundance-effect-estimates}
# ==============================================================================
# Sex-specific Exercise vs Control and Rapamycin vs Control effects
#
# All six Treatment × Sex groups are fitted simultaneously.
# ==============================================================================

estimate_rawsum_effects_one_bin <- function(df_bin) {

  empty_out <- tibble(
    Comparison = rep(c("Exercise - Control", "Rapamycin - Control"), each = 2),
    Sex = rep(c("Female", "Male"), times = 2),
    log2FC = NA_real_,
    SE = NA_real_,
    CI_low = NA_real_,
    CI_high = NA_real_,
    p_value = NA_real_
  )

  dd <- df_bin %>%
    mutate(
      Group = factor(
        paste(as.character(Treatment), as.character(Sex), sep = "_"),
        levels = c(
          "Control_Female",
          "Exercise_Female",
          "Rapamycin_Female",
          "Control_Male",
          "Exercise_Male",
          "Rapamycin_Male"
        )
      )
    )

  if (nlevels(droplevels(dd$Group)) < 6) {
    return(empty_out)
  }

  fit <- tryCatch(lm(Log2_raw_sum ~ 0 + Group, data = dd), error = function(e) NULL)

  if (is.null(fit)) {
    return(empty_out)
  }

  b <- coef(fit)

  V <- vcov(fit)

  df_res <- df.residual(fit)

  coef_names <- names(b)

  get_contrast <- function(compare_trt, sex_name) {

    ctl_name <- paste0("GroupControl_", sex_name)

    trt_name <- paste0("Group", compare_trt, "_", sex_name)

    if (!all(c(ctl_name, trt_name) %in% coef_names)) {
      return(
        tibble(
          Comparison =
            paste0(compare_trt, " - Control"),
          Sex =
            sex_name,
          log2FC =
            NA_real_,
          SE =
            NA_real_,
          CI_low =
            NA_real_,
          CI_high =
            NA_real_,
          p_value =
            NA_real_
        )
      )
    }

    cvec <- rep(0, length(b))

    names(cvec) <- coef_names

    cvec[trt_name] <- 1

    cvec[ctl_name] <- -1

    estimate <- sum(cvec * b)

    se <- sqrt(as.numeric(t(cvec) %*% V %*% cvec))

    tcrit <- qt(0.975, df = df_res)

    t_stat <-
      estimate /
      se

    tibble(
      Comparison =
        paste0(compare_trt, " - Control"),

      Sex =
        sex_name,

      log2FC =
        estimate,

      SE =
        se,

      CI_low =
        estimate -
        tcrit *
          se,

      CI_high =
        estimate +
        tcrit *
          se,

      p_value =
        2 *
        pt(-abs(t_stat), df = df_res)
    )
  }

  bind_rows(
    get_contrast("Exercise", "Female"),

    get_contrast("Exercise", "Male"),

    get_contrast("Rapamycin", "Female"),

    get_contrast("Rapamycin", "Male")
  )
}

rawsum_effects <- rawsum_sample %>%
  filter(Bin %in% bin_order_figure, !Bin %in% bins_to_remove_display) %>%
  group_by(Bin) %>%
  group_modify(~ estimate_rawsum_effects_one_bin(.x)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(Comparison, Sex) %>%
  mutate(FDR = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    Comparison = factor(Comparison, levels = c("Exercise - Control", "Rapamycin - Control")),

    Sex = factor(Sex, levels = c("Female", "Male"))
  )

write.csv(rawsum_effects, file.path(stats_dir, "RawSum_TreatmentEffects_log2FC_bySex.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

rawsum_effects
```

# Detection-frequency analysis

For each protein, pairwise two-sided Fisher exact tests compare Control vs Exercise and Control vs Rapamycin detection prevalence. The source workflow combines those two nominal p-values using Fisher's combined-probability method; this value is retained as `p_pooled` for continuity with the existing detection figures. BH FDR is calculated for both pairwise tests and for the combined p-value across proteins.

The relaxed figures below use:

- **robust detection:** detected in ≥2 samples;
- **singleton:** detected in exactly 1 sample;
- **absent:** detected in 0 samples.

```{r detection-analysis}
build_detection_stats <- function(long_df) {

  det <- long_df %>%
    mutate(Detected = Intensity > 0) %>%
    group_by(Protein.Group, Gene1, Bin, Treatment) %>%
    summarise(detected_n = sum(Detected, na.rm = TRUE), total_n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Treatment, values_from = c(detected_n, total_n), names_sep = "_")

  test_pair <- function(a_det, a_total, b_det, b_total) {

    if (any(is.na(c(a_det, a_total, b_det, b_total)))) {
      return(NA_real_)
    }

    mat <- matrix(c(a_det, a_total - a_det, b_det, b_total - b_det), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)

    tryCatch(fisher.test(mat)$p.value, error = function(e) NA_real_)
  }

  combine_fisher <- function(pvals) {

    pvals <- pvals[!is.na(pvals) & is.finite(pvals) & pvals > 0 & pvals <= 1]

    if (length(pvals) == 0) {
      return(NA_real_)
    }

    stat <- -2 *
      sum(log(pvals))

    pchisq(stat, df = 2 * length(pvals), lower.tail = FALSE)
  }

  det %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      p_control_vs_exercise = test_pair(
        detected_n_Control,
        total_n_Control,
        detected_n_Exercise,
        total_n_Exercise
      ),

      p_control_vs_rapamycin = test_pair(
        detected_n_Control,
        total_n_Control,
        detected_n_Rapamycin,
        total_n_Rapamycin
      ),

      p_pooled = combine_fisher(c(p_control_vs_exercise, p_control_vs_rapamycin))
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      FDR_control_vs_exercise = p.adjust(p_control_vs_exercise, method = "BH"),

      FDR_control_vs_rapamycin = p.adjust(p_control_vs_rapamycin, method = "BH"),

      FDR_pooled = p.adjust(p_pooled, method = "BH")
    )
}

det_stats_all <- build_detection_stats(long_assigned)

det_stats_min2 <- build_detection_stats(long_filt)
```

## Relaxed detection plots

The final detection plots are detection-only displays rather than abundance dot plots:

- filled dot = robust detection (≥2);
- hollow dot = singleton detection (1);
- grey X = absent (0).

Prevalence labels are shown only for robustly detected groups. Significant pooled Fisher p-values and protein names are bolded at raw p ≤ 0.05.

```{r relaxed-detection-plots, fig.keep="none"}
bin_pal_detect <- pal

make_relaxed_detection_plot <- function(plot_df, title_text, file_name) {

  if (nrow(plot_df) == 0) {
    message("No proteins for: ", title_text)
    return(NULL)
  }

  plot_df <- plot_df %>%
    left_join(
      protein_bin_export %>%
        select(
          Protein.Group,
          Gene1,
          Bin,
          mean_intensity_Control,
          mean_intensity_Exercise,
          mean_intensity_Rapamycin
        ) %>%
        distinct(),
      by = c("Protein.Group", "Gene1", "Bin")
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      p_label = fmt_p_detection(p_pooled),

      p_fontface = if_else(!is.na(p_pooled) & p_pooled <= 0.050, "bold", "plain"),

      Gene1_label = if_else(!is.na(p_pooled) & p_pooled <= 0.050, paste0("**", Gene1, "**"), Gene1)
    ) %>%
    arrange(
      factor(Bin, levels = bin_priority),
      p_pooled,
      desc(detected_n_Control),
      desc(mean_intensity_Control),
      Gene1
    )

  used_bins <- bin_priority[bin_priority %in% unique(plot_df$Bin)]

  plot_df <- plot_df %>%
    mutate(Gene1 = factor(Gene1, levels = rev(unique(Gene1))), Bin = factor(Bin, levels = used_bins))

  gene_label_map <- stats::setNames(plot_df$Gene1_label, as.character(plot_df$Gene1))

  state_long <- plot_df %>%
    select(Protein.Group, Gene1, Bin, starts_with("detected_n_"), starts_with("total_n_")) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = c(
        detected_n_Control,
        total_n_Control,
        detected_n_Exercise,
        total_n_Exercise,
        detected_n_Rapamycin,
        total_n_Rapamycin
      ),
      names_to = c(".value", "Treatment"),
      names_pattern = "(detected_n|total_n)_(.*)"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Treatment = dplyr::recode(Treatment, Control = "Old Ctl", Exercise = "Old+Ex", Rapamycin = "Old+Rapa"),
      Treatment = factor(Treatment, levels = c("Old Ctl", "Old+Ex", "Old+Rapa")),
      x_pos = case_when(
        as.character(Treatment) == "Old Ctl" ~ 1.00,
        as.character(Treatment) == "Old+Ex" ~ 1.65,
        as.character(Treatment) == "Old+Rapa" ~ 2.30,
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      ),
      state = case_when(detected_n >= min_detect_n ~ "robust", detected_n == 1 ~ "singleton", TRUE ~ "absent"),
      prev_label = sprintf("%d/%d", detected_n, total_n),
      show_label = state == "robust"
    )

  p_df <- plot_df %>%
    select(Gene1, p_label, p_fontface) %>%
    distinct()

  p_x <- 2.72

  row_guides <- tibble(Gene1 = levels(plot_df$Gene1))

  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_segment(
      data = row_guides,
      aes(x = 0.72, xend = 2.55, y = Gene1, yend = Gene1),
      colour = "grey92",
      linewidth = nm_style$detection_row_line
    ) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(1.00, 1.65, 2.30), colour = "grey92", linewidth = nm_style$detection_row_line) +
    geom_point(
      data = state_long %>%
        filter(state == "absent"),
      aes(x = x_pos, y = Gene1),
      shape = 4,
      size = nm_style$detection_open,
      colour = "grey70",
      stroke = nm_style$detection_stroke
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = state_long %>%
        filter(state == "singleton"),
      aes(x = x_pos, y = Gene1, colour = Bin),
      shape = 1,
      size = nm_style$detection_open,
      stroke = nm_style$detection_stroke
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = state_long %>%
        filter(state == "robust"),
      aes(x = x_pos, y = Gene1, colour = Bin),
      shape = 16,
      size = nm_style$detection_filled
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = state_long %>%
        filter(show_label),
      aes(x = x_pos, y = Gene1, label = prev_label),
      nudge_x = 0.08,
      hjust = 0,
      size = nm_style$detection_prevalence_label,
      colour = "grey25"
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = p_df,
      aes(x = p_x, y = Gene1, label = p_label, fontface = p_fontface),
      hjust = 0,
      size = nm_style$detection_p_label,
      colour = "grey35",
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_colour_manual(
      values = bin_pal_detect[used_bins],
      breaks = used_bins,
      drop = TRUE,
      name = "Cellular Component"
    ) +
    scale_y_discrete(labels = gene_label_map) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = c(1.00, 1.65, 2.30, p_x),
      labels = c("Old Ctl", "Old+Ex", "Old+Rapa", ""),
      position = "top",
      expand = expansion(add = c(0, 0.62))
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    labs(
      title = title_text,
      subtitle = paste0("n = ", nrow(plot_df), " proteins"),
      caption = paste0(
        "Filled dot = robust detection (≥2); ",
        "hollow dot = singleton (1); ",
        "grey X = absent (0). ",
        "* denotes pooled Fisher p ≤ 0.05."
      ),
      x = NULL,
      y = NULL
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(colour = "grey40", size = 11),
      plot.caption = element_text(colour = "grey45", size = 8, hjust = 0.5),
      axis.text.y = ggtext::element_markdown(size = 9.5),
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        face = "bold",
        size = nm_style$axis_text,
        colour = c(
          treatment_cols[["Control"]],
          treatment_cols[["Exercise"]],
          treatment_cols[["Rapamycin"]],
          "grey25"
        )
      ),
      axis.line = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks = element_blank(),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "right",
      plot.margin = margin(10, 60, 10, 10)
    )

  out_file <- file.path(detect_dir, file_name)

  save_plot_png(p, out_file, width = 8.8, height = max(5, nrow(plot_df) * 0.28 + 2.0))

  p
}
```

# Top insoluble proteins by cellular component

The combined dot plot ranks proteins independently within each cellular component by **Old Control abundance**, then displays those same proteins in Old Control, Old+Exercise, and Old+Rapamycin. Only the eight selected cellular-component panels are retained. Dot size represents log10 mean intensity.

```{r top10-dotplot, fig.keep="none"}
dot_bin_order <- bin_order_figure[bin_order_figure %in% unique(protein_bin_export$Bin)]

top10_data <- purrr::map_dfr(
  dot_bin_order,
  function(bin_name) {

    top_bin <- protein_bin_export %>%
      filter(Bin == bin_name, !is.na(mean_intensity_Control), mean_intensity_Control > 0) %>%
      arrange(desc(mean_intensity_Control)) %>%
      slice_head(n = 10) %>%
      mutate(Rank_Control = row_number(), GeneLabel = make.unique(as.character(Gene1)))

    if (nrow(top_bin) == 0) {
      return(NULL)
    }

    top_bin %>%
      select(
        Protein.Group,
        GeneLabel,
        Bin,
        Rank_Control,
        mean_intensity_Control,
        mean_intensity_Exercise,
        mean_intensity_Rapamycin
      ) %>%
      pivot_longer(
        cols = c(mean_intensity_Control, mean_intensity_Exercise, mean_intensity_Rapamycin),
        names_to = "Group",
        values_to = "Intensity"
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        Group = dplyr::recode(
          Group,
          mean_intensity_Control = "Old Ctrl",
          mean_intensity_Exercise = "Old+Ex",
          mean_intensity_Rapamycin = "Old+Rapa"
        ),
        Group = factor(Group, levels = c("Old Ctrl", "Old+Ex", "Old+Rapa")),
        log10_int = if_else(!is.na(Intensity) & Intensity > 0, log10(Intensity), NA_real_),
        Bin = factor(Bin, levels = dot_bin_order)
      )
  }
)

write.csv(top10_data, file.path(dot_dir, "Top10_AllBins_data.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

all_log10 <- top10_data$log10_int

all_log10 <- all_log10[is.finite(all_log10)]

size_limits <- c(floor(min(all_log10, na.rm = TRUE)), ceiling(max(all_log10, na.rm = TRUE)))

size_breaks <- pretty(range(all_log10, na.rm = TRUE), n = 4)

size_breaks <- size_breaks[size_breaks >= size_limits[1] & size_breaks <= size_limits[2]]

shared_size_scale <- scale_size_continuous(
  name = expression(log[10](Intensity)),
  range = c(nm_style$top10_bubble_min, nm_style$top10_bubble_max),
  limits = size_limits,
  breaks = size_breaks
)

bin_pal_dot <- pal[dot_bin_order]

make_top10_panel <- function(bin_name, show_size_legend = FALSE) {

  panel_df <- top10_data %>%
    filter(as.character(Bin) == bin_name)

  if (nrow(panel_df) == 0) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  gene_order <- panel_df %>%
    distinct(GeneLabel, Rank_Control) %>%
    arrange(Rank_Control) %>%
    pull(GeneLabel)

  panel_df <- panel_df %>%
    mutate(GeneLabel = factor(GeneLabel, levels = rev(gene_order)))

  bin_col <- bin_pal_dot[[bin_name]]

  ggplot(panel_df, aes(x = Group, y = GeneLabel, size = log10_int)) +
    geom_point(colour = bin_col, alpha = 0.90, na.rm = TRUE, show.legend = show_size_legend) +
    shared_size_scale +
    guides(size = guide_legend(override.aes = list(colour = "grey35", alpha = 1))) +
    scale_x_discrete(position = "top", drop = FALSE) +
    labs(title = bin_name, x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = nm_style$component_heading, colour = bin_col, hjust = 0),
      axis.text.x.top = element_text(size = nm_style$top10_group_pt, face = "bold", margin = margin(b = 3)),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = nm_style$top10_protein_pt, colour = "black"),
      axis.line = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "grey92", linewidth = nm_style$bubble_grid_line),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey93", linewidth = nm_style$bubble_grid_line),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
      plot.margin = margin(t = 4, r = 5, b = 4, l = 5)
    )
}

top10_plot_list <- purrr::imap(
  dot_bin_order,
  function(bin_name, panel_number) {
    make_top10_panel(bin_name = bin_name, show_size_legend = panel_number == 1)
  }
)

top10_plot_list <- purrr::compact(top10_plot_list)

combined_dotplot <- patchwork::wrap_plots(top10_plot_list, ncol = 4) +
  patchwork::plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
  patchwork::plot_annotation() &
  theme(legend.position = "right", legend.justification = "center", legend.box = "vertical")

dotplot_png <- file.path(dot_dir, "Top10_AllBins.png")

save_plot_png(combined_dotplot, dotplot_png, width = 13, height = 7.2)
```

## Pooled Top-10 relative-abundance bubble plot

The absolute-abundance bubble plot above is complemented by a **within-protein relative-abundance** view with Female and Male mice pooled within treatment. The same Old-Control-ranked Top-10 proteins are used.

For each protein, `log10(mean intensity)` is centered across Old Control, Old+Exercise, and Old+Rapamycin:

\[
centered\ log_{10} =
group\ log_{10}(mean\ intensity) -
protein\ mean\ log_{10}(mean\ intensity)
\]

Color indicates the direction of the within-protein deviation and bubble size indicates its magnitude. This plot emphasizes relative treatment-associated patterns; it should not be used to compare absolute abundance between different proteins.

```{r pooled-top10-relative-bubble-data}
top10_pooled_relative <- top10_data %>%
  group_by(Protein.Group) %>%
  mutate(
    protein_mean_log10 = if (any(is.finite(log10_int))) {
      mean(log10_int, na.rm = TRUE)
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },

    centered_log10 = if_else(
      is.finite(log10_int) &
        is.finite(protein_mean_log10),
      log10_int -
        protein_mean_log10,
      NA_real_
    ),

    deviation_magnitude =
      abs(centered_log10)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

write.csv(top10_pooled_relative, file.path(dot_dir, "Top10_Pooled_RelBubbles_data.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

pooled_relative_absmax <- max(abs(top10_pooled_relative$centered_log10), na.rm = TRUE)

if (!is.finite(pooled_relative_absmax) || pooled_relative_absmax == 0) {
  pooled_relative_absmax <- 1
}

pooled_relative_size_breaks <- pretty(c(0, pooled_relative_absmax), n = 4)

pooled_relative_size_breaks <- pooled_relative_size_breaks[
  pooled_relative_size_breaks >= 0 &
    pooled_relative_size_breaks <=
      pooled_relative_absmax
]
```

```{r pooled-top10-relative-bubble-plot, fig.keep="none"}
pooled_relative_plot_list <- list()

for (i in seq_along(dot_bin_order)) {

  bin_name <- dot_bin_order[i]
  bin_col  <- bin_pal_dot[[bin_name]]

  panel_df <- top10_pooled_relative %>%
    filter(as.character(Bin) == bin_name)

  if (nrow(panel_df) == 0) {
    next
  }

  gene_order <- panel_df %>%
    distinct(GeneLabel, Rank_Control) %>%
    arrange(Rank_Control) %>%
    pull(GeneLabel)

  panel_df <- panel_df %>%
    mutate(
      GeneLabel = factor(GeneLabel, levels = rev(gene_order)),

      Group = factor(Group, levels = c("Old Ctrl", "Old+Ex", "Old+Rapa"))
    )

  p <- ggplot(panel_df, aes(x = Group, y = GeneLabel)) +

    geom_point(
      data =
        panel_df %>%
        filter(!is.na(centered_log10)),
      aes(size = deviation_magnitude, colour = centered_log10),
      alpha = 0.92
    ) +

    geom_point(
      data =
        panel_df %>%
        filter(is.na(centered_log10)),
      shape = 4,
      size = nm_style$bubble_missing,
      stroke = nm_style$bubble_missing_stroke,
      colour = "grey65"
    ) +

    scale_colour_gradient2(
      low = "#3B528B",
      mid = "grey92",
      high = "#D62728",
      midpoint = 0,
      limits = c(-pooled_relative_absmax, pooled_relative_absmax),
      oob =
        scales::squish,
      name = expression(Delta ~ log[10]("intensity"))
    ) +

    scale_size_continuous(
      range = c(nm_style$top10_bubble_min, nm_style$top10_bubble_max),
      limits = c(0, pooled_relative_absmax),
      breaks =
        pooled_relative_size_breaks,
      name =
        "|centered value|"
    ) +

    scale_x_discrete(position = "top", limits = c("Old Ctrl", "Old+Ex", "Old+Rapa"), drop = FALSE) +

    labs(title = bin_name, x = NULL, y = NULL) +

    theme_classic(base_size = 11) +

    theme(
      plot.title =
        element_text(face = "bold", size = nm_style$component_heading, colour = bin_col),

      axis.text.x.top =
        element_text(size = nm_style$top10_group_pt, face = "bold"),

      axis.text.y =
        element_text(size = nm_style$top10_protein_pt),

      axis.line =
        element_blank(),

      axis.ticks =
        element_blank(),

      panel.grid.major.x =
        element_line(colour = "grey93", linewidth = nm_style$bubble_grid_line),

      panel.grid.major.y =
        element_line(colour = "grey93", linewidth = nm_style$bubble_grid_line),

      panel.grid.minor =
        element_blank(),

      legend.position =
        if (i == 1) {
          "right"
        } else {
          "none"
        }
    )

  pooled_relative_plot_list[[bin_name]] <- p
}

  patchwork::wrap_plots(pooled_relative_plot_list, ncol = 4) +

  patchwork::plot_layout(guides = "collect") +

  theme(legend.position = "right")
```

## Pooled Top-5 relative-abundance bubble plot (compact Extended Data companion)

This uses the **five highest Old-Control mean-abundance proteins per cellular
component**, retaining the exact same three-treatment means and within-protein
centered values as the Top-10 plot. Both versions use the **same full Top-10
color and bubble-size scale limits**, allowing direct comparison. Component
headings are preserved; no overall plot title or subtitle is added.

```{r pooled-top5-relative-bubble-plot, fig.keep="none"}
stopifnot(exists("top10_pooled_relative"), exists("pooled_relative_absmax"),
          exists("pooled_relative_size_breaks"), exists("bin_pal_dot"))

# Rank_Control was assigned within component using pooled Old-Control abundance.
# This is a FILTER only: group means and centered values are not recalculated.
top5_pooled_relative <- top10_pooled_relative %>%
  dplyr::filter(Rank_Control <= 5L) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Group = factor(as.character(Group), levels = c("Old Ctrl", "Old+Ex", "Old+Rapa")))

readr::write_csv(top5_pooled_relative, file.path(dot_dir, "Top5_Pooled_RelBubbles_data.csv"))

pooled_top5_panels <- list()
for (bin_name in dot_bin_order) {
  panel_df5 <- top5_pooled_relative %>%
    dplyr::filter(as.character(Bin) == bin_name)
  if (nrow(panel_df5) == 0L) next

  labels <- panel_df5 %>%
    dplyr::distinct(GeneLabel, Rank_Control) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(Rank_Control) %>%
    dplyr::pull(GeneLabel)
  panel_df5 <- panel_df5 %>%
    dplyr::mutate(GeneLabel = factor(GeneLabel, levels = rev(labels)))

  p5 <- ggplot2::ggplot(panel_df5, ggplot2::aes(x = Group, y = GeneLabel)) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(
      data = panel_df5 %>% dplyr::filter(is.finite(centered_log10)),
      ggplot2::aes(size = deviation_magnitude, colour = centered_log10),
      alpha = 0.92
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(
      data = panel_df5 %>% dplyr::filter(!is.finite(centered_log10)),
      shape = 4, size = nm_style$top5_rel_missing,
      stroke = nm_style$top5_rel_stroke, colour = "grey65"
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_colour_gradient2(
      low = "#3B528B", mid = "grey92", high = "#D62728", midpoint = 0,
      limits = c(-pooled_relative_absmax, pooled_relative_absmax),
      oob = scales::squish,
      name = expression(Delta ~ log[10]("intensity"))
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_size_continuous(
      range = c(nm_style$top5_rel_bubble_min, nm_style$top5_rel_bubble_max),
      limits = c(0, pooled_relative_absmax),
      breaks = pooled_relative_size_breaks,
      name = "|centered value|"
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_x_discrete(
      position = "top", drop = FALSE,
      labels = c("Old Ctrl" = "Ctl", "Old+Ex" = "Ex", "Old+Rapa" = "Rapa")
    ) +
    ggplot2::labs(title = bin_name, x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    ggplot2::theme_classic(base_size = 8) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(
        face = "bold", size = nm_style$component_heading,
        colour = bin_pal_dot[[bin_name]]
      ),
      axis.text.x.top = ggplot2::element_text(size = nm_style$top5_rel_group_pt, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_text(size = nm_style$top5_rel_protein_pt),
      axis.line = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      axis.ticks = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.x = ggplot2::element_line(colour = "grey94", linewidth = 0.14),
      panel.grid.major.y = ggplot2::element_line(colour = "grey94", linewidth = 0.14),
      panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      legend.position = "right",
      plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(2, 2, 2, 2)
    )
  pooled_top5_panels[[bin_name]] <- p5
}

pooled_top5_combined <- patchwork::wrap_plots(pooled_top5_panels, ncol = 4) +
  patchwork::plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "right")

pooled_top5_png <- file.path(dot_dir, "Top5_Pooled_RelBubbles.png")

  width = nm_dims$Top5_Pooled_RelBubbles[["width"]] / 25.4,
  height = nm_dims$Top5_Pooled_RelBubbles[["height"]] / 25.4,
  dpi = nm_export$dpi
)
```
